public.scope: Gradient kinds, transforms and stops; solid alpha is paint opacity.

public.scope: Shadow geometry, progressive blur, beta noise/texture/glass, shader effect; no variable binding on noise/texture/glass.

public.scope: An effect list and supported variable references.

public.scope: Paint list for fills/strokes; not a complete border or component material.

public.scope: @utility and variants; not an Area guard/part compiler.

public.scope: Gradient geometry is part of the rendering syntax.
